issues: A 118px two-line centred title; 80% of the frame is empty light grey, like a placeholder slide
The marker is a thin near-black line the same colour as the type — weak material contrast, it reads like an underline style from afar
Flat-cut stroke start and a straight-edged reveal window, so the stroke has no pen tip; nothing changes after it's drawn
The title is a single block blur-slide; apart from the stroke there is no typographic hierarchy or content
changes: Look switched to sand; bold grotesk poster: eyebrow → 250px / 800 two-line 'Meet the new / Lumen AI.' spanning the width → 40px body copy + a dark CTA pill
The marker is now terracotta, multiplied over the type (ink stays black, paper takes the colour), ~0.16em wide mid-stroke — the only accent colour and the only hand-made mark on screen

Rebuilt stroke shape: an ink blob and rounded start, a thinning upward flick at the end; reveal = rectangle + a round pen tip travelling along the stroke axis; the ink 'dries' one step over 8f (0.96→0.86)
Title rises word by word from a mask (second line 6f later), then a 6f pause before the pen lands; one 10f EASE.out stroke, low-left to high-right following the italic
84f timeline: 2–26 title / 32–42 stroke / 42–50 drying / 44–62 body and CTA (spring damping 16) / 22f hold, push-in 1→1.02
